graph.rule: attribute(prompt, max_n_logits=10, desired_logit_prob=0.95); prune_graph(graph, node_threshold, edge_threshold=0.8) at each level; nodes and edges kept at any level are stored (circuit-tracer’s default edge_threshold=0.98 keeps about 0.6 million edges per graph at node_threshold=0.8)
graph.edge: A[target, source]: the direct effect of the source (activation × decoder row, an error vector, a token embedding) on the target (a feature’s pre-activation, or a logit minus the mean logit) with attention patterns and norm scales frozen

steering.rule: the subject token’s feature nodes that prune_graph keeps at circuit-tracer’s defaults (node_threshold=0.8, edge_threshold=0.98); each set to m × its activation by adding (m − 1)·a·W_dec to its layer’s MLP output at that position, in the real model; swap: set to 0 and the other prompt’s subject features added at their activations

text.rule: The SAE tab's sample: the first 384 non-heading paragraphs of the test split with at least 64 tokens, cut to <bos> + 64 tokens
